PINTAR production origin — forensic request

Read-only. Deploys nothing, writes no environment value, touches no Supabase
configuration.

attempt:  005
purpose:  establish what the PUBLIC certificate-verification surface actually
          serves, because activation stage 1's functional check returned an
          unexpected 401.

finding under test:
          /api/verifikasi/<token> returned 401 {"error":"unauthenticated"}.
          That response comes from src/proxy.ts, not from the route handler.
          The middleware's PUBLIC_PREFIXES is ["/verifikasi/"], which covers
          the PAGE but not the API beneath it.

          The page at /verifikasi/[token] fetches its own
          ${appUrl()}/api/verifikasi/<token> over HTTP, so that request
          re-enters the same middleware anonymously. If it is refused, the
          page can only ever render its not-found state.

          public_surface_registry declares the API "Anonymously reachable, and
          declared as such", and assert_public_surface() asserts the database
          declaration -- not the middleware. So the two may have drifted.

          This run measures both surfaces rather than reasoning further.
